warning: This file is EMPTY on purpose. SailWise does not ship webcam URLs it has not verified: a link to a camera that does not exist is worse than an empty section, because a sailor plans around having a look and then has nothing. Add cameras you actually use — see data/webcams/README.md.
attribution_note: Each webcam belongs to whoever operates it. Record the owner, link to their page rather than hotlinking their image where their terms require it, and respect any embedding restrictions.
ics_note: Not applicable to webcams; see data/events/events.json for calendar feeds.
